== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sarcoline City is a walled urban center located within the monster-filled wilderness of [[Harness]]. While its exterior walls appear monotonous, the interior is a vibrant environment populated by diverse groups of people and creatures of various sizes. The city serves as a hub where travelers move through its gates alongside many different types of monsters. It is noted for being free of Tyrakki scout [[spores]] and contains ancient monsters that can be used to empower certain [[scripts]]. The city is part of a network of walled settlements, and news or legends originating there spread quickly to other similar locations. Within the city lies [[Eternity]], a busy headquarters that functions like a smaller, walled version of Sarcoline City itself.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Located within [[Harness]], Sarcoline City is a colorful urban center characterized by its smooth, pale peach-colored [[stone]] walls and gates. The city serves as a bustling hub where various people travel alongside monsters of many different sizes. During his travels, [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] passed through the location and discovered that its fortifications were too resilient for his normal [[madra]] to penetrate.}}
